Final-stage high regions exceed random controls in 21/22 mean-fill cases and 18/22 blur cases. Earlier-stage resolution does not consistently improve this comparison. Individual exceptions and baseline sensitivity remain; for cloud_267.jpeg, blur removal increases the Sunrise logit even in high-ranked regions. The diagnostic is an enriched sample from one checkpoint. Occlusion creates artificial images, and random controls are not population confidence intervals. No causal or statistical-significance claim is made.

Part 16 - Inference and Latency¶

The actual prediction function enforces evaluation mode, applies model-specific preprocessing, synchronizes accelerators and computes four softmax scores. Its single-forward timer includes softmax but excludes preprocessing and loading. The benchmark separately times network forwards only: batch one, five warm-ups and 30 synchronized repetitions on the same resident tensor. Original reported latencies are MPS measurements; the live example is labeled with its current device and does not overwrite them.

In [53]:
def predict_image(model, image, architecture, device):
    if any(module.training for module in model.modules()):
        raise ValueError("Call model.eval() before inference")
    if image.width * image.height > 25_000_000:
        raise ValueError("Use an image smaller than 25 megapixels")
    if max(image.size) / min(image.size) > 64:
        raise ValueError("Use an image with an aspect ratio no greater than 64:1")
    x = transform("test", False, architecture)(image.convert("RGB")).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
    synchronize(device)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    with torch.inference_mode():
        probabilities = model(x).softmax(1)[0]
    synchronize(device)
    latency = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
    values = probabilities.cpu().tolist()
    if len(values) != 4 or not np.isfinite(values).all():
        raise RuntimeError("Model returned invalid probabilities")
    return {"class_id": int(np.argmax(values)), "label": CLASSES[int(np.argmax(values))],
            "confidence": max(values), "probabilities": values, "latency_ms": latency}
In [54]:
def benchmark(model, sample, device, warmup=5, repeats=30):
    if warmup < 1 or repeats < 2:
        raise ValueError("Latency requires at least one warm-up and two repetitions")
    sample = sample.to(device)
    measurements = []
    with torch.inference_mode():
        for _ in range(warmup):
            model(sample)
        synchronize(device)
        for _ in range(repeats):
            synchronize(device)
            start = time.perf_counter()
            model(sample)
            synchronize(device)
            measurements.append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
    return {"median_ms": float(np.median(measurements)), "mean_ms": float(np.mean(measurements)),
            "std_ms": float(np.std(measurements)), "p95_ms": float(np.percentile(measurements, 95)),
            "measurements_ms": measurements, "warmup": warmup, "repeats": repeats,
            "batch_size": 1, "includes_preprocessing": False, "includes_device_transfer": False,
            "synchronization": device.type if device.type in {"cuda", "mps"} else "not_required",
            "protocol": "Same provided tensor, resident on device; forward pass only, inference_mode; no softmax, disk I/O, or model loading",
            "environment": environment(device)}

Part 18 - Streamlit Application¶

The working application remains app.py: python -m streamlit run app.py. It supports image upload, camera capture and dataset examples; cached trained models; four class scores; device/browser information; optional average latency; same-image comparison; Grad-CAM; and result/report downloads. The screenshot is genuine saved app footage.

The application helpers below are executable notebook-local definitions. The following complete source appendix reproduces the actual app.py, CLI and styling for inspection, rather than inventing a second app. The appendix is deliberately not executed inside the Jupyter kernel: Streamlit is launched through its normal entrypoint in the repository. Its package imports refer to the same implementations shown in this notebook.

def decode_upload(content: bytes) -> Image.Image:
    if not content:
        raise ValueError("The image file is empty.")
    if len(content) > 12 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise ValueError("Choose a file smaller than 12 MB.")
    with Image.open(io.BytesIO(content)) as image:
        if image.format not in {"JPEG", "PNG", "WEBP"}:
            raise ValueError("Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.")
        if image.width * image.height > 25_000_000:
            raise ValueError("Choose an image smaller than 25 megapixels.")
        if max(image.size) / min(image.size) > 64:
            raise ValueError("Choose an image with an aspect ratio no greater than 64:1.")
        image.load()
        return ImageOps.exif_transpose(image).convert("RGB")


def example_catalog(manifest: Path, root: Path, limit=6) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    """Offer only existing test images located inside the project."""
    result = {label: [] for label in LABELS}
    if not manifest.is_file():
        return result
    frame = pd.read_csv(manifest)
    if not {"path", "label", "split"}.issubset(frame.columns):
        return result
    root = root.resolve()
    for row in frame[frame.split == "test"].itertuples():
        label = str(row.label).title()
        if label not in result or len(result[label]) >= limit:
            continue
        path = (root / str(row.path)).resolve()
        if path.is_relative_to(root) and path.is_file():
            result[label].append(str(path))
    return result


def sync_image_state(state: MutableMapping, content: bytes | None) -> str | None:
    """Keep results across display changes, discard them when the input changes."""
    digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() if content is not None else None
    if state.get("active_image") != digest or "image_predictions" not in state:
        state["active_image"] = digest
        state["image_predictions"] = {}
        state["image_heatmaps"] = {}
        state["comparison_shown"] = False
    return digest


def result_key(digest: str, run: str, device: str, modified: int) -> tuple:
    return digest, run, device, modified


def export_prediction(prediction, model_name: str, device: str, filename: str, size) -> bytes:
    document = {
        "image": {"name": Path(filename).name, "width": size[0], "height": size[1]},
        "model": model_name,
        "predicted_class": prediction["label"].title(),
        "softmax_confidence": prediction["confidence"],
        "class_scores": dict(zip(LABELS, prediction["probabilities"], strict=True)),
        "device": device.upper(),
        "forward_ms": prediction["latency_ms"],
        "timing": "One synchronized forward including softmax; excludes decoding, preprocessing, transfer, loading, and Grad-CAM",
    }
    if 'environment' in prediction:
        document['environment'] = prediction['environment']
    if 'server_prediction_ms' in prediction:
        document['server_prediction_ms'] = prediction['server_prediction_ms']
        document['server_timing'] = 'Model retrieval, preprocessing and forward; excludes upload, decoding, browser rendering and optional benchmark'
    document['browser_user_agent'] = prediction.get('browser_user_agent', 'Unavailable')
    if 'benchmark' in prediction:
        document['benchmark'] = prediction['benchmark']
    return (json.dumps(document, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode()

"""WeatherVision local application: trained models, predictions, and explanations."""
from __future__ import annotations

import html
import json
import threading
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import streamlit as st
import torch
from PIL import Image, UnidentifiedImageError

from src.app_utils import (MODEL_SPECS, RUN_LABELS, decode_upload, example_catalog,
                           export_prediction, result_key, sync_image_state)
from src.data import transform
from src.engine import load_checkpoint, predict_image
from src.evaluation import benchmark
from src.explainability import gradcam_convnext, overlay_image, heatmap_image
from src.utils import LABELS, ROOT, select_device, environment

st.set_page_config(page_title="WeatherVision", page_icon=":material/partly_cloudy_day:", layout="wide")
torch.set_num_threads(4)
st.markdown(f"<style>{(ROOT / '.streamlit/style.css').read_text() if (ROOT / '.streamlit/style.css').exists() else ''}</style>", unsafe_allow_html=True)


@st.cache_resource(show_spinner=False, max_entries=6)
def cached_model(path: str, modified: int, device_name: str):
    model, checkpoint = load_checkpoint(path, device_name)
    return model, checkpoint, threading.RLock()


@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)
def cached_catalog(manifest_path: str, modified: int, root: str):
    return example_catalog(Path(manifest_path), Path(root))


@st.cache_data(show_spinner=False)
def cached_file(path: str, modified: int):
    return Path(path).read_bytes()


def read_file(path: Path):
    return cached_file(str(path), path.stat().st_mtime_ns)


def clear_image():
    st.session_state['upload_generation'] = st.session_state.get('upload_generation', 0) + 1
    st.session_state['image_source'] = 'Upload'
    sync_image_state(st.session_state, None)


def classify_one(name, image, device, key):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    path = ROOT / 'outputs' / MODEL_SPECS[name]['run'] / 'best.pt'
    model, checkpoint, lock = cached_model(str(path), path.stat().st_mtime_ns, str(device))
    architecture = MODEL_SPECS[name]['architecture']
    if checkpoint['config']['model'] != architecture:
        raise ValueError('Checkpoint does not match the selected model.')
    with lock:
        prediction = predict_image(model, image, architecture, device)
    prediction['server_prediction_ms'] = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
    prediction['environment'] = environment(device)
    previous = st.session_state.image_predictions.get(key, {})
    if 'benchmark' in previous:
        prediction['benchmark'] = previous['benchmark']
    prediction['browser_user_agent'] = st.context.headers.get('User-Agent', 'Unavailable')
    st.session_state.image_predictions[key] = prediction
    if previous.get('class_id') != prediction['class_id']:
        st.session_state.image_heatmaps.pop(key, None)
    return prediction


def prediction_html(prediction):
    name = html.escape(prediction['label'].title())
    rows = []
    for i, (label, value) in enumerate(zip(LABELS, prediction['probabilities'], strict=True)):
        selected = ' is-selected' if i == prediction['class_id'] else ''
        percent = max(0.0, min(100.0, value * 100))
        rows.append(f'<div class="score-row{selected}"><span>{label}</span>'
                    f'<div class="score-track"><div class="score-fill" style="width:{percent:.3f}%"></div></div>'
                    f'<span class="score-number">{value:.1%}</span></div>')
    return (f'<div class="prediction-summary"><span class="prediction-class">{name}</span>'
            f'<span class="prediction-score">{prediction["confidence"]:.1%}</span></div>'
            '<div class="result-caption">Softmax confidence</div>'
            f'<div class="score-list">{"".join(rows)}</div>')


def show_failure(message, error):
    st.error(message)
    with st.expander('Error details'):
        st.code(str(error), language=None)


ready = [name for name, spec in MODEL_SPECS.items() if (ROOT / 'outputs' / spec['run'] / 'best.pt').is_file()]
manifest_path = ROOT / 'data/manifest.csv'
try:
    catalog = cached_catalog(str(manifest_path), manifest_path.stat().st_mtime_ns, str(ROOT)) if manifest_path.exists() else {}
except (OSError, ValueError, pd.errors.ParserError):
    catalog = {}
has_examples = any(catalog.values())

brand, availability = st.columns([3, 1], vertical_alignment='center')
with brand:
    st.title('WeatherVision')
    st.markdown('<div class="brand-description">Weather image classification</div>', unsafe_allow_html=True)
with availability:
    status_text = f'{len(ready)} models ready' if ready else 'Models unavailable'
    status_class = '' if ready else ' unavailable'
    st.markdown(f'<div class="header-status"><span class="availability{status_class}"><span class="availability-dot"></span>{status_text}</span></div>', unsafe_allow_html=True)

classify_tab, experiments_tab, project_tab = st.tabs(['Classify', 'Experiments', 'Project'])

with classify_tab:
    with st.container(key='classify_workspace'):
        workspace, result_column = st.columns([1.18, 1], gap='large')
        with workspace:
            st.subheader('Photograph')
            source = st.segmented_control('Image source', ['Examples', 'Upload', 'Camera'],
                                          default='Examples' if has_examples else 'Upload',
                                          key='image_source', required=True, label_visibility='collapsed', width='stretch')
            content, filename, original = None, 'photograph.jpg', None
            if source == 'Examples':
                categories = [label for label in LABELS if catalog.get(label)]
                if categories:
                    category = st.pills('Example category', categories, default=categories[0],
                                        key='sample_category', required=True, label_visibility='collapsed')
                    index = st.session_state.get(f'example_index_{category}', 0) % len(catalog[category])
                    path = Path(catalog[category][index])
                    try:
                        content = read_file(path)
                        filename = path.name
                    except OSError as error:
                        show_failure('Example is unavailable. Upload a photograph to continue.', error)
                else:
                    st.info('Upload a photograph to begin. Dataset examples are unavailable.')
            else:
                generation = st.session_state.get('upload_generation', 0)
                upload = (st.camera_input('Take a photograph', key=f'camera_{generation}') if source == 'Camera'
                          else st.file_uploader('Upload a photograph', type=['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'webp'],
                                                key=f'upload_{generation}', help='JPG, PNG, or WebP. Up to 12 MB, 25 megapixels, and 64:1 aspect ratio.'))
                if upload is not None:
                    content, filename = upload.getvalue(), upload.name
            if content is not None:
                try:
                    original = decode_upload(content)
                    with st.container(key='image_preview'):
                        st.image(original, width='stretch')
                    st.caption(f'{original.width} × {original.height} px  ·  {source}')
                except (UnidentifiedImageError, OSError, ValueError, Image.DecompressionBombError) as error:
                    st.error('Cannot read this image. Choose a different JPG, PNG, or WebP file.')
                    with st.expander('Image details'):
                        st.write(str(error))
            else:
                st.markdown('''<div class="photo-empty"><svg width="42" height="42" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="3"/><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.5"/><path d="m3 17 5-5 4 4 3-3 6 6"/></svg><strong>Add a photograph</strong><span>Upload an image, choose an example,<br>or take a photo with your camera.</span></div>''', unsafe_allow_html=True)
            if content is not None:
                with st.container(key='image_actions'):
                    actions = st.columns(2)
                    if source == 'Examples' and categories:
                        if actions[0].button('Another example', icon=':material/refresh:', width='stretch'):
                            st.session_state[f'example_index_{category}'] = index + 1
                            st.rerun()
                    actions[1].button('Clear image', icon=':material/close:', on_click=clear_image, width='stretch')
        digest = sync_image_state(st.session_state, content if original is not None else None)
        with result_column:
            st.subheader('Classifier')
            selected = st.selectbox('Model', list(MODEL_SPECS), index=2, key='selected_model')
            spec = MODEL_SPECS[selected]
            st.caption(spec['description'])
            with st.expander('Prediction settings'):
                selected_device = st.radio('Inference device', ['CPU', 'Automatic'], horizontal=True, key='inference_device')
                st.caption('Automatic selects CUDA or Apple MPS when available.')
                st.caption('Forward time includes softmax; image preparation and model loading are excluded.')
            device = select_device('cpu' if st.session_state.get('inference_device', 'CPU') == 'CPU' else 'auto')
            checkpoint_path = ROOT / 'outputs' / spec['run'] / 'best.pt'

                with st.expander('Checkpoint setup'):
                    st.code('python scripts/download_checkpoints.py', language='bash')
            if st.button('Classify image', type='primary', icon=':material/arrow_forward:',
                         disabled=not available or original is None, width='stretch'):
                try:

                except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError, KeyError) as error:
                    st.session_state.image_predictions.pop(key, None)
                    show_failure('Could not classify this image. Try another model or CPU inference.', error)
            prediction = st.session_state.image_predictions.get(key)
            if prediction:
                st.markdown(prediction_html(prediction), unsafe_allow_html=True)

                st.caption(f'{selected} · Server prediction: {prediction["server_prediction_ms"]:.1f} ms' if 'server_prediction_ms' in prediction else selected)

                    st.caption('Optional benchmark: batch 1; five warm-ups and 30 measurements on this image. Accelerator calls are synchronized. Excludes softmax, image preparation, transfer, loading, and Grad-CAM. The single forward above includes softmax. Measurements are cached for this image, model, device and checkpoint version.')
                    env = prediction.get('environment') or environment(device)
                    st.write(f'Inference backend: {env["device"].upper()} · Python {env["python"]} · PyTorch {env["torch"]} · TorchVision {env["torchvision"]} · {env["threads"]} CPU threads')
                    st.caption(env['platform'])
                    st.text('Browser (reported User-Agent): ' + prediction['browser_user_agent'])
                st.download_button('Download result', export_prediction(prediction, selected, str(device), filename, original.size),

            else:

                               icon=':material/download:', on_click='ignore', help='PNG of the displayed overlay with the selected opacity.')
            if raw_view:
                raw_buffer = io.BytesIO(); heatmap_image(heatmap).save(raw_buffer, format='PNG')
                st.download_button('Download raw heatmap', raw_buffer.getvalue(), 'weathervision_raw_gradcam.png', 'image/png', on_click='ignore')
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as error:
            show_failure('Could not generate the heatmap. Try CPU inference.', error)

with experiments_tab:

Complete command-line entrypoint (inspection appendix)¶

"""WeatherVision command line.

Run `python weather_cv.py --help`; the app and notebook use these same modules.
"""
import argparse
import logging
from pathlib import Path

from src.config import load_config
from src.data import obtain_dataset, prepare_dataset, verify_content
from src.engine import train
from src.evaluation import compare_runs, evaluate_run, regenerate_figures
from src.explainability import generate_examples
from src.utils import ROOT, environment


def parser():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="WeatherVision: reproducible four-class scene classification")
    p.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT, help="Project root (default: directory containing this script)")
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    prep = sub.add_parser("prepare", help="Download, audit, deduplicate, and create one split")
    prep.add_argument("--local-zip", type=Path)
    prep.add_argument("--source-dir", type=Path)
    prep.add_argument("--data-dir", type=Path)
    prep.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    prep.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="Rebuild manifest; existing checkpoints will reject changed splits")
    training = sub.add_parser("train", help="Train one named configuration; never reads test images")
    training.add_argument("--config", type=Path, default=ROOT / "configs/experiments.yaml")
    training.add_argument("--run", required=True)
    training.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=ROOT / "data/manifest.csv")
    training.add_argument("--outputs", type=Path, default=ROOT / "outputs")
    training.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true")
    training.add_argument("--skip-complete", action="store_true")
    training.add_argument("--device", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    evaluation = sub.add_parser("evaluate", help="Evaluate finalized configurations on the shared test split")
    evaluation.add_argument("--runs", nargs="+", default=["cnn_baseline", "mobilenet_improved", "convnext_aug", "convnext_noaug"])
    evaluation.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=ROOT / "data/manifest.csv")
    evaluation.add_argument("--outputs", type=Path, default=ROOT / "outputs")
    evaluation.add_argument("--device", default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    evaluation.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=5)
    evaluation.add_argument("--repeats", type=int, default=30)
    explain = sub.add_parser("explain", help="Save real ConvNeXt test-set Grad-CAM examples after evaluation")
    explain.add_argument("--run", default="convnext_aug")
    explain.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=ROOT / "data/manifest.csv")
    explain.add_argument("--outputs", type=Path, default=ROOT / "outputs")
    explain.add_argument("--count", type=int, default=6)
    explain.add_argument("--device", default="auto", choices=["auto", "cpu", "cuda", "mps"])
    plots = sub.add_parser("figures", help="Rebuild charts from stored CSV/JSON without training")
    plots.add_argument("--outputs", type=Path, default=ROOT / "outputs")
    sub.add_parser("doctor", help="Print dependency versions, hardware, and checkpoint availability")
    return p


def main():
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")
    args = parser().parse_args()
    root = args.root.resolve()
    try:
        if args.command == "prepare":
            import pandas as pd
            directory = args.data_dir or root / "data"
            manifest = directory / "manifest.csv"
            if manifest.exists() and not args.force:
                import json
                statistics = json.loads((directory / "statistics.json").read_text())
                if statistics["seed"] != args.seed:
                    raise ValueError("Existing manifest uses a different seed; use a new data directory")
                frame = pd.read_csv(manifest)
                # Portable archives preserve the split while omitting raw images.
                if not all((root / value).is_file() for value in frame.path):
                    obtain_dataset(directory, args.local_zip, args.source_dir)
                verify_content(frame, root)
                print("Reusing verified manifest; --force explicitly rebuilds it.")
            else:
                source = obtain_dataset(directory, args.local_zip, args.source_dir)
                frame = prepare_dataset(source, directory, root, args.seed)
            print(pd.crosstab(frame.label, frame.split))
        elif args.command == "train":
            from dataclasses import replace
            configs = load_config(args.config)
            if args.run not in configs:
                raise ValueError(f"Unknown run {args.run}; choose one of {list(configs)}")
            config = configs[args.run]
            if args.device:
                config = replace(config, device=args.device)
            train(args.run, config, args.manifest, args.outputs / args.run, root, args.resume, args.skip_complete)
        elif args.command == "evaluate":
            # Validate every run before touching test data, preventing partial comparisons.
            import json
            for run in args.runs:
                status = json.loads((args.outputs / run / "status.json").read_text())
                if status["state"] != "complete":
                    raise ValueError(f"Finalize training first: {run}")
            if {"convnext_aug", "convnext_noaug"}.issubset(args.runs):
                from src.config import Experiment, validate_ablation
                validate_ablation(*[Experiment(**json.loads((args.outputs / run / "status.json").read_text())["config"])
                                    for run in ("convnext_aug", "convnext_noaug")])
            for run in args.runs:
                metrics = evaluate_run(run, args.manifest, args.outputs, root, args.device, args.warmup, args.repeats)
                print(f"{run}: test accuracy={metrics['accuracy']:.4f}, macro-F1={metrics['f1_macro']:.4f}")
            print(compare_runs(args.runs, args.outputs).to_string(index=False))
        elif args.command == "explain":
            print(generate_examples(args.outputs / args.run, args.manifest, root, args.count, args.device))
        elif args.command == "figures":
            regenerate_figures(args.outputs)
        elif args.command == "doctor":
            import json
            info = environment()
            info["checkpoints"] = {run: (root / "outputs" / run / "best.pt").is_file()
                                   for run in load_config(root / "configs/experiments.yaml")}
            print(json.dumps(info, indent=2))
    except (ValueError, RuntimeError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
        raise SystemExit(f"WeatherVision: {e}") from e


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Part 19 - Conclusion and Limitations¶

A1 shows a gain from pretrained MobileNetV2 features over the small CNN: 96.36% versus 95.15% accuracy. A2 extends the same comparison with ConvNeXt-Tiny's deeper hierarchy and larger spatial filters, reaching 98.18% accuracy and 0.9827 macro-F1. Both transfer models train only their new linear heads, which makes the experiments practical for a small labeled dataset. Simple CNN remains the smallest and fastest network on the measured MPS workload.

Augmentation adds one correct test prediction and 0.0068 macro-F1 in the ConvNeXt pair. This single-seed result does not establish statistical significance or a universal benefit. The test set has only 165 images, labels overlap visually, duplicate grouping is heuristic, and unseen locations, cameras or lighting may reduce performance. Softmax scores are uncalibrated and the classifier has no unrelated-image rejection class.

Grad-CAM is coarse class-score attribution, not segmentation or causal proof. Equal-area occlusion adds a limited sensitivity check with baseline-dependent exceptions. All training photographs come from the credited CC BY 4.0 dataset; none are generated. The published demo uses actual app capture and disclosed synthetic narration. Uploaded photographs are processed in server memory rather than saved by the app.

The default run uses official saved data and notebook-local implementations without retraining or replacing the original outputs. The optional reproduction branches use separate directories and remain unexecuted in the displayed demonstration. Hardware and library differences can change floating-point results; CPU/MPS Grad-CAM comparisons allow an absolute tolerance of 0.00001. The original reports and prior notebooks remain available alongside this complete implementation.
